_note: Per-case framing overrides for frame_reconstruction_cameras.py. KITTI is a road corridor ~60 m deep. A hard off-axis view turns it into a sliver and a near-axial one strands it at the far end of the frame, so keep a moderate 3/4 and move in: its points are concentrated near the road while a few far ones set the 98th-percentile angle, so the shared distance target leaves it small. Its recordings are also built with --no-path.
